decisions.summary: Dual-source the Fabric panel type 1 (Nova): qualify Martinez Pitts and Smith [SYNTH] as an alternate to Flowers-Gomez [SYNTH] after the 2024 Shenzhen typhoon

messages.author: EMP-N-001
messages.text: After the typhoon we can't stay single-sourced on the Fabric panel type 1 (Nova) from Flowers-Gomez [SYNTH]. Nine days without batteries took out a whole product line.

messages.author: EMP-N-002
messages.text: Flowers-Gomez [SYNTH] is about 12% cheaper than anyone else. Dual-sourcing the battery pack raises unit cost and we lose volume discounts.

messages.author: EMP-N-010
messages.text: Legal view: the Flowers-Gomez [SYNTH] contract has a force majeure clause that covers typhoons, so we had no recourse for the stoppage. Penalties won't protect us here.

messages.author: EMP-N-003
messages.text: Martinez Pitts and Smith [SYNTH] in CN passed the qualification audit last week. They can take 30% of the battery volume within a quarter.

messages.author: EMP-N-001
messages.text: Decision: we dual-source the Fabric panel type 1 (Nova). Martinez Pitts and Smith [SYNTH] becomes the qualified alternate and stays on standby until their capacity ramps; we also keep three weeks of safety stock.

messages.author: EMP-N-002
messages.text: Agreed. I'll update the sourcing policy and the supplier master.

title: Should we dual-source the Fabric panel type 1 (Nova)?
